prompts.source: Use case: product-mockup. Create one original synthetic source image for a transparent, clearly disclosed AI image-reconstruction portfolio experiment. An unbranded matte kraft-paper stand-up pouch photographed straight-on on a light warm-gray studio background. On the front is a highly detailed printed illustration of a circular miniature forest world: a mossy rocky cliff, one narrow central waterfall flowing down into a turquoise crescent pool, one crooked broadleaf tree at upper left, small ferns and pale flowers along the bottom, a small amber sun glow at upper right, and three delicate gold orbital arcs behind the round illustrated world. The sphere illustration is fully inside the front face of the pouch with a little space around its edges, occupies about sixty percent of the pouch front, and remains readable despite subtle package wrinkles, faded print and a slight paper texture. A realistic product mockup with complex fine botanical detail, restrained greens/teal/warm gold. Blank packaging: no brand, no words, no letters, no logo, no watermark. This is an invented study object, not a real client product. Keep the entire pouch and the source artwork visible. Portrait composition.
prompts.reconstruction: Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. EDIT TARGET: the attached ORIGINAL synthetic kraft-pouch mockup. Extract and carefully reconstruct ONLY its existing printed botanical circular artwork as one clean reusable high-resolution PNG on a truly transparent background. Remove the physical pouch, studio background, paper colour cast, print fading, package wrinkles and package shadows. Preserve the source artwork's composition and distinctive geometry: the SAME crooked tree branching from the upper left with the same major branch directions, the same central narrow waterfall and stepped mossy cliffs, the turquoise pool at the bottom, the pale flowers and fern positions, the small warm sun at upper right, and the same three delicate gold orbital curves and their small dots. Keep the positions and proportions relative to one another. Retain all protruding foliage and the gold arcs with transparent space around the complete silhouette. Carefully recover printed fine details rather than redesigning or adding new scene objects. Match the restrained forest green/teal/amber palette while removing the brown bag substrate. Do not place the extracted art onto a new bag, circle frame, rectangle, white background or checkerboard. No text, brand, logos or watermarks. The outcome must be the isolated existing botanical illustration with real alpha transparency; not a different forest scene. Aim for faithful reconstruction; do not invent an unrelated tree, move the waterfall, add more waterfalls, shift the sun or change the orbital paths.
prompts.edgeCorrection: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an isolated botanical illustration with alpha. Image 2 is the original pouch reference for composition only. Make exactly one targeted correction to Image 1: clean the extraction boundary. Remove the unwanted neon-yellow, orange and red jagged patches and colour fringes between the tree leaves, around the upper sky boundary, and around the gold orbital arcs. Keep only the intentional fine muted-gold curves and dots plus the actual leaves/branches/artwork, with smooth natural anti-aliased edges and genuine alpha transparency in all surrounding empty areas. There must be no bright yellow filler islands, red edge pixels, black matte, white matte, checkerboard texture, paper fragments or broad coloured glow behind the arcs. Do not change the tree shape, waterfall, cliffs, pool, flowers, sun, artwork layout or main colour grading. Do not redesign the source motif. The interior waterfall/forest scene must remain fully opaque; fine foliage and the separate gold arcs must have clean transparent surroundings. Preserve the complete artwork with a little transparent margin, no clipping. No text or logo. Deliver a clean PNG on a truly transparent background.
